items.text: Baker Mayfield (thumb) is out; Jalon Daniels makes his third straight start (already the listed starter in the model).
Tampa Bay is also without S Antoine Winfield Jr. and WR David Sills V; CB Benjamin Morrison is doubtful.
Pittsburgh is without WR Roman Wilson and S DeShon Elliott; CB Jalen Ramsey, RB Rico Dowdle and TE Pat Freiermuth are questionable.
Saturday: WR DK Metcalf (illness) is off the injury report and good to go; TE Pat Freiermuth (calf) remains questionable.

adjust.reason: Tampa Bay's secondary is missing its best safety with its top rookie CB doubtful. Pittsburgh has several questionable starters, so this is kept small. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
